vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Off deliberately: this repo automates @radoslavirha/* only, and a security PR for any other dependency would land without a matching review workflow. Revisit if the scope below widens.

packageRules.description: Nothing is automated by default. @radoslavirha/* is opted back in below; every other dependency stays a deliberate manual bump.

toolkit-hub packages are released together and consumed only through the pnpm catalog, so they travel as a single PR. rangeStrategy 'bump' is what makes the catalog track releases at all: under the default 'replace' an in-range release (^0.5.7 -> 0.5.8) would change only pnpm-lock.yaml and the catalog entry would silently drift behind. registryUrls is not redundant with the root .npmrc: Renovate attaches a package file's .npmrc to package.json files only, so catalog entries in pnpm-workspace.yaml would otherwise be looked up on registry.npmjs.org and every one of them would 404.

Patch and minor merge themselves once the workspace verify job is green. Majors always wait for a human. platformAutomerge is off above because the repo has allow_auto_merge disabled and no branch protection, so Renovate must check the branch status itself rather than hand the merge to GitHub.
